PREFACE.

This is a companion volume to the Khasi-English Dictionary 
by the some author which was published by Government in 1900.

In his letter dated the 1st February 1907 to Government the 
author wrote : —

“ So far as the arrangement of the English words is concerned, 1 claim 
no originality in the matter ; they have been put down %s they are in an 
ordinary popular English Dictionary. The pronunoia.. at in English have 
specially wen given to meet the wants of Kha i students."

Agreeably to the sanction oonveyed in Government letter 
No. 41450., dated the 30th March 1907, the late U Nissor Singh 
prepared the manuscript of this Dictionary whioh was revised by 
a Committee composed of the following gentlemen —

! (Mr. F. E. Jackson,

Mr. L. 0. Clarke and 
Mr. B. C. Allen).

Bai Sahib Dohory Ropmay,

U -Hajom Kissor Singh,

U Nissor Singh (the author).

The Committee were assisted by the following gentlemen to 
each of whom was allotted for revision tho manuscript of one or 
more letters of the Alphabet : — .

The Rev. Walter Firminger (now Aioh*Deacon of 
Calcutta),

The late Rev. C. L. Stephens,

The Rev. J. C. Evans, and 
Khan Sahib Amjad Ali,

to whom the best thanks of the Committee aro due.

After having been passed by tho Revision Committee the 
manuscripts were sent to the Secretariat l’ress letter by letter. 
The author read the proofs from the letter A to part of O 
which were sent to him from time to time as they were issued 
from the Press until his death at Tura, Garo Hills, which took 
place on the 20th February 1918 at the age of 48 years. Tho 
proofs of the remaining letters were read by U H. K. Singh who 
also wrote the Key to pronu liciation and the lists of abbrevia 
tions.

The author was an enthusiast in the cause ot education, the 
following being a list of his works : —

The Kbasi-English Dictionary (published by the Assam 
Secretariat Press.)

Hints on the Study of the Kbasi Language.

Kbasi Arithmetic.

Khasi Mental Arithmetic.

Mental Arithmetic in the Garo Language (not publi- 
shed).

JKa skul bad U Nonghikai (The 8chool and the 
Teacher), published by the Ei Khasi Press, Maw khan 
Shillong.

It is hoped that this book will supply a long-felt want and 
will serve as a good foundation for any improvements which may 
be made in the future.

A. W. DENTITH.

Shillong :

Septemler 1020

Deputy Commissioner, 
Khaii and Jain it a Hills.
